description_for_human: Gaming investment intelligence — real-time signals on M&A, fundraising, layoffs, and product launches across 200+ gaming companies.
description_for_model: Use this to get gaming industry investment signals. Returns structured data on M&A, fundraising, layoffs, earnings, and product launches for gaming companies. Each signal has a type, investment relevance score (0-1), and tagged companies. Public signals available without auth; full item/entity data requires API key.
